text:
Type: long wooden TV bench with drawers
Use: holding a TV and media devices, storing games and remotes; living room, family room
Style: traditional, farmhouse, Scandinavian
Materials: solid wood with a dark stained finish, round metal knobs
Colors: dark black-brown, dark grey knobs
Shape: long low cabinet with three open cubbies above three drawers, small round knobs, overhanging flat top, framed side panels, short square legs, sturdy and wide, heavy visual weight
Feel: warm, solid, homey, classic
Goes with: white walls, warm wood floors, cream or beige sofas; traditional, farmhouse or country living rooms

product.name: HEMNES
product.description: Solid wood has a natural feel.
